held_through: Reviewed peer source and process admission
shared_gate_contract.existing_circuit_policy: Never cleared or replaced. Presence blocks all requests regardless of elapsed cooldown.
shared_gate_contract.denied_or_interrupted_sources: Already denied and durable unfinished starts retain terminal or unresolved dispositions, with no automatic retry.
shared_gate_contract.airbnb_prior_process_resume: Carried own timing requires the same candidate hash and a confirmed retired prior PID. A second live Airbnb owner is rejected.
shared_gate_contract.netflix_publisher_lock: Airbnb does not acquire it. The reviewed V2 may retain it during concurrent capture.

changed_admission_boundary.prior_candidate_policy: The legacy peer must finish and its archive must verify under an exclusive publisher lock. This old candidate remains unchanged.
changed_admission_boundary.new_candidate_policy: Only the exact reviewed atomic V2 may run concurrently. Its source, process and progress identities and OS command are revalidated under the shared request lock before every GET and during pacing waits. Legacy, unknown or inconsistent owners fail closed.
changed_admission_boundary.stopped_v2_policy: The same reviewed source and process identity must remain; finished metadata and OS process absence must agree. No legacy stopped metadata is accepted.

compatibility_risks: Unix flock is advisory. Coordinated participants must use the same lock and controls; a noncooperating owner can ignore them.
Source hashes, process metadata and OS commands are identity evidence, not a guarantee against hostile source replacement or process impersonation.
An owner transition outside the shared lock can race metadata reads. Inconsistent process or progress identities stop admission and preserve the pending queue for review.
The candidate rejects a Netflix budget PID that differs from the reviewed current process. A new handoff may remain ineligible until that process records its first slot.
The first renewed rate limit, source denial, challenge or non RSS success opens the persistent stop; elapsed cooldown never clears it.
The reviewed Netflix successor uses its existing Retry After parser and controller. This report verifies valid numeric and HTTP date behavior, not a new guarantee for every malformed peer header.
OS command inspection is validated on the current macOS host. Other OS command formats and permission restrictions remain a host coverage gap.
Wall clock changes, malformed controls or missing identity files can delay or halt progress. No fairness or host availability guarantee is established.
capture_limits: Bulk capture keeps deliberate article reading gain at zero.
Original complete response entity bytes remain separate from XML decoded content, which resolves entities and normalizes line endings.
Automatic text can omit images, unescaped code markup and linked resources.
Next relations are preserved for later review; this candidate processes exactly the bound 92 routes.
Historical pagination and lifetime completeness remain unresolved.
